name: AI Semantic Parser & Automated Inbox Triage

parameters.content:
# AI SEMANTIC PARSER
## Automated Inbox Triage Pipeline

**Problem solved:** Operations teams waste thousands of hours manually reading inbound emails, extracting data, and routing tickets. This pipeline replaces that human middleware entirely.

**Architecture:** The LLM is used NOT as a chatbot, but as a rigid **data extraction API** — it reads unstructured email text and outputs a predictable, machine-readable JSON object. Standard logic nodes then take over.

```
Webhook / IMAP
  └──► LLM Parser (GPT-4o-mini)
          └──► JSON Structurer (Code Node)
                  └──► Switch (Intent + Urgency)
                          ├── 🚨 CRITICAL  ──► Notion Ticket + Slack Escalation
                          └── 📋 STANDARD  ──► Notion Ticket (Standard Queue)
```

**Processing time target: < 3 seconds per email**

## Ingestion Layer

Two options to configure:

**Option A — Webhook (recommended for testing):**
Send a `POST` request with this body:
```json
{
  "subject": "Urgent: Order #4521 not delivered",
  "body": "Hi, I'm John Smith. My order #4521 placed 2 weeks ago has still not arrived. I am extremely frustrated and will dispute the charge if this isn't resolved today."
}
```

**Option B — IMAP Email Read:**
Replace this node with an `Email Read (IMAP)` node connected to `support@yourcompany.com`. Map `subject` and `text` fields downstream.

⚙️ The webhook path is `/email-ingest`. Copy the Production URL into your testing tool (Postman, curl, etc.).

## LLM Semantic Parser

Uses **GPT-4o-mini** (fast + low cost) as a strict data extraction API.

**System prompt enforces:**
- Return ONLY a valid JSON object
- No conversational text, no markdown, no code fences
- Extract exactly 4 fields:
  - `CustomerName` → string
  - `OrderID` → string or null
  - `Intent` → `"Support"` | `"Quote"` | `"Complaint"`
  - `UrgencyScore` → integer 1–5


**The sub-node `OpenAI Chat Model` must be connected** to this node via the AI/model port (the bottom connection point labeled "AI Model").

## Intent Router (Switch)

Evaluates two fields from the parsed JSON:
- `UrgencyScore >= 4` OR `Intent == "Complaint"` -> Critical / Fast-Track
- Everything else -> Standard Queue


⚙️ **To customize thresholds:**
- Change `4` to `3` to catch more cases in the critical lane
- Add a third rule: `Intent == "Quote"` → Sales lane (Output 2)
- Adjust to match your SLA definitions


The Switch uses `OR` logic on Output 0 — either condition alone is enough to escalate.

## 🚨 CRITICAL LANE
### UrgencyScore ≥ 4 OR Intent = "Complaint"

**Step A — Notion Ticket (High Priority):**
Creates a fully-populated support ticket in the Notion database with:
- All extracted fields pre-filled
- Status: `Critical`
- Assignee: Customer Success Manager queue
- SLA target: Response within 1 hour

**Step B — Slack Escalation:**
Instantly pings `#cs-escalations` with a formatted alert containing the full parsed context. The CSM can respond directly from Slack.


**Goal:** Human eyes on the problem within minutes, zero manual reading required.

## 📋 STANDARD LANE
### UrgencyScore < 4 AND Intent ≠ "Complaint"

**Notion Ticket (Standard Queue):**
Creates a support ticket in Notion with:
- All extracted fields pre-filled
- Status: `Pending`
- Assigned to: standard support queue rotation
- SLA target: Response within 24 hours


**No human alert fired.** The ticket sits in the standard queue and is handled in order of arrival.

💡 Tip: connect a follow-up node here to auto-send an acknowledgement email to the customer using the `Send Email` node.

## ⚙️ SETUP CHECKLIST

**Before going live:**

- [ ] Add your **OpenAI API Key** to the `OpenAI Chat Model` node credentials
- [ ] Test the webhook with at least 2 payloads: one high-urgency complaint and one standard inquiry
- [ ] Create a **Notion database** with columns: `Customer Name`, `Order ID`, `Intent`, `Urgency Score`, `Status`, `Raw Email`, `Created At`
- [ ] Add your **Notion Integration Token** to the Notion node credentials
- [ ] Insert your **Notion Database ID** in both Notion nodes
- [ ] Add your **Slack Bot Token** to the Slack node credentials
- [ ] Set the Slack channel name to your escalation channel (e.g. `#cs-escalations`)
- [ ] Review and adjust the Switch threshold (`UrgencyScore >= 4`) to match your SLA
- [ ] (Optional) Replace the Webhook node with an `Email Read (IMAP)` node for production use
- [ ] Publish the workflow

messageValues.message:
=You are a strict data extraction API. Your only function is to read the email provided and extract structured information. You must return ONLY a single valid JSON object. Do not include any conversational text, explanation, markdown formatting, or code fences. If a field cannot be determined from the email, use null for strings and 3 for UrgencyScore.

Extract the following fields:
- CustomerName: string — the full name of the sender if mentioned, otherwise null
- OrderID: string — any order/ticket/reference number (e.g. #4521, ORD-992), otherwise null
- Intent: string — exactly one of: "Support", "Quote", "Complaint"
- UrgencyScore: integer — a score from 1 (low urgency) to 5 (extreme urgency) based on the tone and content
